import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Matrix {
        int[][] val;
        int n;

        public Matrix(int nn, int x) {
            n = nn;
            val = new int[n][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (i != j) {
                        val[i][j] = 0;
                    } else {
                        val[i][j] = x;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        public int[] operator[](int x) {
            return val[x];
        }

        public Matrix operator*(Matrix b) {
            Matrix ans = new Matrix(n, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        ans.val[i][k] = (ans.val[i][k] + (int) ((long) val[i][j] * b.val[j][k] % 1000000007)) % 1000000007;
                    }
                }
            }
            return ans;
        }

        public Matrix operator+(Matrix b) {
            Matrix ans = new Matrix(n, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    ans.val[i][j] = (val[i][j] + b.val[i][j]) % 1000000007;
                }
            }
            return ans;
        }

        public boolean operator==(Matrix b) {
            if (n != b.n) {
                return false;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (val[i][j] != b.val[i][j]) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    public static Matrix operator^(Matrix a, long b) {
        Matrix ans = new Matrix(a.n, 1);
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                ans = ans * a;
            }
            a = a * a;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static Matrix get(long n, int ind, Matrix[] a, Matrix[] shift, int[] val, int k) {
        if (n == 0) {
            return new Matrix(k + 1, 1);
        }

        for (int i = ind; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (n >= val[i]) {
                Matrix tmp = get(n % val[i], i - 1, a, shift, val, k);
                int x = (int) (n / val[i]);

                Matrix ans = a[i];
                for (int j = 1; j < x; j++) {
                    ans = ans * shift[k - 1];
                    ans = ans * a[i];
                }
                ans = ans * shift[k - 1];
                ans = ans * tmp;
                ans = ans * shift[x - 1];
                return ans;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(1 / 0);
        return new Matrix(k + 1, -800);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int k = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().split(" ")[1]);

        int[] val = new int[60];
        val[0] = 1;

        int last = 60;
        for (int i = 1; i < 60; i++) {
            if (val[i - 1] >= 2e18 / k) {
                val[i] = (int) 2e18;
                last = i;
                break;
            } else {
                val[i] = val[i - 1] * k;
            }
        }

        Matrix[] shift = new Matrix[32];
        shift[0] = new Matrix(k + 1, 1);
        shift[1] = new Matrix(k + 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            shift[1].val[i][(i - 1 + k) % k] = 1;
        }
        shift[1].val[k][k] = 1;

        for (int i = 2; i < k; i++) {
            shift[i] = shift[i - 1] * shift[1];
        }

        Matrix[] a = new Matrix[60];
        for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
            a[i] = new Matrix(k + 1, 1);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            a[0].val[i][0] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < last; i++) {
            Matrix tmp = a[i - 1];

            a[i] = a[i - 1];

            for (int j = 1; j < k; j++) {
                a[i] = a[i] * shift[k - 1];
                a[i] = a[i] * tmp;
            }

            a[i] = a[i] * shift[k - 1];
        }

        Matrix ans = new Matrix(k + 1);
        ans.val[0][k] = 1;

        ans = ans * get(Long.parseLong(br.readLine().split(" ")[0]), last - 1, a, shift, val, k);

        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            res = (res + ans.val[0][i]) % 1000000007;
        }

        pw.println(res);
        pw.close();
    }
}
